create_benchmark_system_fcc: create a BenchmarkSystem with an FCC crystal structure and a specified number of atoms
create_benchmark_system_water_box: create a BenchmarkSystem with a water box structure containing a specified number of molecules
create_benchmark_system_slab_adsorbate: create a BenchmarkSystem with a slab adsorbate structure for surface catalysis tasks
get_default_benchmark_systems: get a list of four default benchmark systems covering molecules, bulk, and slab tasks
make_variable_size_batch: make a batch of FCC benchmark systems with varying atom counts for scalability testing
